notes.title: Triple Take is Officially Released
notes.content:
[i]You are always on the lookout for the perfect ways to spend some time with challenging but fun little games. We're happy to let you know you can fill in that gap in your soul now. Triple Take is out on Steam today, on October 6th with a price of 6.99 USD/EUR and a 20% discount.[/i]

[b]Triple Take[/b] is simple but yet cute and amusing in its visual style. You play in a (un)vibrantly coloured world inside of your computer which in cursed by an entity trying to corrupt the whole game! You must complete the levels in order to beat the entity and save the game.

But wait! The entity makes you play each level three times, and it keeps making the level harder and harder with each try!

[previewyoutube=in-v3bj_PfU;full][/previewyoutube]

[h2]The main features of the game:
[/h2]
[list]
[*] The game breaks the fourth wall: an entity corrupts the game, and you must complete tasks on your computer AND beat each level three times as it evolves making your task harder and harder
[*] Simple yet amusing and cute art style, soundtrack, and story keep you entertained for the whole over 50 levels
[*] Puzzles, precision, skills, challenges, wall jumps, traps... What else would you need!
[*] Triple Take is out now, on October 6th on Steam with a price of 6.99 USD/EUR and a 20% release discount, so get it now.
[/list]


Triple Take on Steam: [url=https://store.steampowered.com/widget/1734250/]https://store.steampowered.com/widget/1734250/[/url]

Press and media kit available here: [url=https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1taisPXf2klTbkJSABaq3KP07XqUkYkCb]https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1taisPXf2klTbkJSABaq3KP07XqUkYkCb[/url]

notes.title: Sunblaze has been live for over one month now!
notes.content:
[h3]Like every good relationship, we have our ups and downs. With mostly ups![/h3]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39932393/7df18aab7e26f4c09eba2bfa821c08f43cc86d22.png[/img]

It's been a full month now since the release of Sunblaze. Since then we've had only a few negative reviews and a ton of positivity send our way! We're currently comfortably sitting at "Very Positive" on Steam and (even though we are so close to Overwhelmingly Positive it makes our brain tingle a little bit, we) want to thank you from the bottom of our hearts for all the positivity. Thank you.

Overall the launch went good and our stress levels aren't spiking as much as they were one month a go. We had close to no problems at all with the launch and Sunblaze has got a decent amount of coverage for an indie game since then. We do feel like we could've got a little more but that being said, we are looking forward and want to continue working with Sunblaze and to make everything even better!

What's next for Sunblaze, then? Well we currently do have a small speedrun competition live and are looking to have more of those if people are interested. But that's not all our masterminds are planning. There's more good stuff, and I'm not misguiding you by saying that we have very interesting stuff coming up in the future! (but it's all covered in a mysterious web of secrets for now!)

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39932393/338330d5a67643e2661e2ef1a805f18184ce1966.png[/img]

To keep it short-ish, I won't ramble on any longer. We just wanted to give you an idea about what's up. And to remind you: any ideas you might have, any thoughts and all the questions are very much welcome! We're here both for the game and for the players. We're here for you guys.

- the Sunblaze team

notes.title: Version 1.1.2
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39932393/4bd49905692eba2dfc500232276219fab503294f.png[/img]

Hey guys! From now on we will update the patch notes here as well so that everyone can keep up on what's happening in the game!

- the Sunblaze team

[h2]--- PATCH NOTES ---[/h2]

- fixed a bug where the chapter stats in the chapter select screen aren't always centered
- fixed a bug where spikes could kill you if they're on a jump-through platform and covered by a falling block
- fixed a bug where sometimes the falling block sounds kept looping
- fixed a bug where Josie's hair color was sometimes black
- fixed a bug where you would sometimes die after leaving the fireball mode
- fixed some decorative inconsistencies
- made the last level of chapter 4 hard mode harder to skip
- reworked the saving so a computer crash is less likely to cause a corrupted save file
- the game now keeps more backups of save files
- made improvements for easier livesplit integration
- fixed a typo in the dialogue

notes.title: 10 days after release!
notes.content:
10 days after release and we're still going strong? [h3]Oh yeah.[/h3]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39932393/109017e3494d7707b2d79a74a54f20e8d4838e67.png[/img]

The wait, the release, the hype, the aftermath. It's all been crazy and chaotic (for the team at least, hopefully it seems like we know what we're doing!) but now that the game is out there, it's time to build on the foundation that we have made.

We've had streamers of various sizes, journalists from numerous publications and players from different backgrounds all show love and interest towards Sunblaze. It's been 10 days since the initial release now and we still keep rallying up interest from lots of people who learn about the games existence! And since it's been such a warm welcome for the game, we want to keep bringing people to it.

Have you been enjoying Sunblaze? 

[h3]Leave a Steam review![/h3] 

It's quick and easy and really helps us a lot!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39932393/338330d5a67643e2661e2ef1a805f18184ce1966.png[/img]

Sunblaze has been bringing all kinds of gamers - platformers, speedrunners, adventurers and everyone else as well - together. And since we want to build up on the game, we might be planning something special small little something! No spoilers yet though. 

[h3]Keep your eyes and ears open![/h3]

- the Sunblaze team

notes.title: Sunblaze: Zen mode!
notes.content:
Sunblaze can be hard. But it doesn't have to be inaccessible.

[h3]That's where Zen mode comes in.[/h3]


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39932393/9d986cde677b1fc093bef2caf8fadb5c1683aac4.png[/img]


We want as many people as possible to be able to enjoy Sunblaze. So far things like "difficult", "hard to beat" and "so hard it makes me cry" are all phrases that have been used to describe Sunblaze. But it doesn't always have to be super hard and unforgiving.

Zen mode is a game mode where you can experience the whole Sunblaze story, but without as much of the "so difficult it makes my head hurt" part. The whole experience of the Zen mode is tailored to be more accessible and more easily approachable.

On top of Zen mode we also have accessibility options in the main game for people who want a little more in their platforming kit to get through those brain-twister levels! Because even though we want the journey to be challenging, we still want everyone to have their fun while playing.

[h2]Only 9 days until release! [/h2]

We are exited and terrified, and truly hope that you will enjoy all that we've got in store for you!

See you soon!

- the Sunblaze team

notes.title: It's time to heal your thumbs before the release
notes.content:
It's been a long way to get here, and now is the time for rest. Our fingers need healing and yours should take a break too - for the full release is just around the corner!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39932393/f11e2425ccadf29bb314b8969ef77716030d2d78.png[/img]

It's a sad thing to take away the demo, I know. But we really want to focus on the release of the full version and taking away some extra variables will make it just a little bit easier for us to get everything just right!

We've seen how much some of you have played the demo. [i]Amazing.[/i] We are extremely thankful to everyone who has been with us during this time, and that's all the more reason why we want to focus on making the full version as great as we can for you. A small break before you get to hop on the full experience will only make it all better, I promise!

[h3]To keep it short, here's what's up:[/h3]

- Sunblaze demo will be deactivated some time during [b]May 13th[/b] (so only a few days left!)
- Rest your fingers and lower your stress levels for a couple of weeks
- The full release of Sunblaze will come out [b]June 3rd 6 AM PDT[/b]
- Thank you.

Oh and in case you already haven't, you should join us waiting for the release at Discord:
[url=https://discord.gg/jucwgwjGTz]https://discord.gg/jucwgwjGTz[/url]

[i]See you soon![/i]
- the Sunblaze team
